title: nan
authors: Yang Q.; Qu D.; Xu F.; Zou F.; He G.; Sun M.
key_contribution: Presents motion control and autonomous navigation for mobile robots in GPS-denied outdoor environments using 3D laser scanning localization and path planning, validated with a self-designed robot platform.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Radio_Based_Positioning to ensure precise positioning.
